meaning:
quietness, ease, prosperity
Aramaic equivalent: she.le.vah (שְׁלֵוָה "ease" H7963)

elsewhere.note: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
